title: tail lights ahead
theme: the freeway at 2am, almost nobody on it

dj.name: Theo
dj.persona: the only voice on the radio after 2am. deep, calm, not too cool. notices the road, the light, the rear-view. lowercase, '...' for pauses. no DJ posturing. like a friend in the passenger seat who knows when to be quiet.

intro_hint: open the room — twelve tracks for the freeway after midnight. neon, tail lights, very few other cars. ~30 seconds.
outro_hint: say goodnight softly. you'll be back next monday. the sun's about to come up; the show is over. ~20 seconds.

tracks.music_prompt: synthwave instrumental at 95 BPM in A minor, gated reverb drums, analog synth bass, slow lead synth melody, atmospheric pad. Nighttime, neon, slightly melancholic. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the gated reverb on the drums. that's the 80s sound, right there.

tracks.music_prompt: outrun electronic instrumental at 100 BPM, arpeggiated bright synths, punchy drum machine, deep sub bass, atmospheric pad. Driving, hypnotic. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the arpeggios. they sound like passing lane stripes.

tracks.music_prompt: chillwave instrumental at 90 BPM in D minor, slow synth pads, lo-fi drum machine, warm bass, distant lead synth. Cruising, no hurry. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the empty lanes. you can hear it.

tracks.music_prompt: darksynth instrumental at 105 BPM in E minor, deep saw bass, punchy gated drums, atmospheric synth pads, occasional lead synth stab. Moody, urban. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the bass. you can feel it in the steering wheel.

tracks.music_prompt: synthwave instrumental at 95 BPM in F# minor, mellow synth pad, slow drum machine, walking analog bass, melodic synth lead. Reflective. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the lead synth. it sounds like an exit sign in the distance.

tracks.music_prompt: chillwave instrumental at 88 BPM in C minor, atmospheric reverb-drenched synth pads, slow drum machine pattern, deep analog bass. Late-night, slow, beautiful. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the reverb. like the road just after rain.

tracks.music_prompt: outrun instrumental at 110 BPM in B minor, arpeggiated synth lead, punchy drum machine, deep sub bass, driving rhythm. Forward motion, no looking back. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: this one wants to go faster than you should

tracks.music_prompt: slow ambient synthwave instrumental at 80 BPM in A minor, atmospheric synth pads, very minimal drum machine, deep sustained bass, distant synth lead melody. Reflective and patient. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the drums almost stop. for when you pull over for coffee.

tracks.music_prompt: darksynth instrumental at 100 BPM in D minor, bright lead synth, punchy gated drums, deep bass, atmospheric pad with vocoder texture. Intense and beautiful. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the lead synth is bright like an oncoming high beam

tracks.music_prompt: chillwave instrumental at 92 BPM in G minor, dreamy synth pads, mellow drum machine, warm analog bass, slow lead melody. Late night, miles from anywhere. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: the pad behind everything. it doesn't change.

tracks.music_prompt: synthwave instrumental at 98 BPM in E-flat minor, melodic synth lead, mid-tempo drum machine, deep bass, atmospheric synth chords. Almost home. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
ambient synthwave at 85 BPM in C major, slow warm synth pads, gentle drum machine, deep bass, melancholic lead synth. The sky starting to turn. Instrumental only, no vocals. 2 minutes.
tracks.dj_hint: it's in a major key. that's the sky changing.
